title: Python SCHC sessions survive an authenticated incompatible version update
description: Final ACK/version security review: LinkLayer.create_fragment_sender validates the current peer version only at creation, while accept_authenticated_schc_dio replaces the peer context without revoking already prepared or active SchcSessionManager records. A sender created under compatible v3 can therefore start after the same authenticated signer advertises an incompatible version, and an active transfer can continue under obsolete registry agreement. Bind sender permits/sessions to a monotonic per-signer SCHC-context generation and atomically revoke prepared/active records when an authenticated DIO changes compatibility; same-version refresh may remain valid only if policy is identical. Test compatible-create→mismatch→start rejection, active mismatch abort/invalidation, stale handle rejection, mismatch→compatible recovery, and concurrency with start/ACK/timeout.
